english:
May

10. Sunday. Tone 1 [AK]. Feast of the Coming of the Holy Spirit [Pentecost]. Beginning of the Fast of Elijah.

17. Sunday. Tone 4 [AZ / ADz]. First [Sunday]. Beginning of the Sundays of the Resurrection. Canticle [Harts] Tone 1 [A3 / ADz]: "Who came for salvation." See the order of the Holy Spirit [Pentecost] in the First Volume.

June

28. Sunday. Tone 6 [BCh / BDz]. Vardavar [Transfiguration]. The privilege period [of eating meat] is six weeks. See the order in the First Volume.

July

5. Sunday. Tone 1 [AK]. Second [Sunday]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [B3 / BDz]: "Who from heaven."

6. Monday. Tone 6 [BCh / BDz]. Of Bishop Cyprian, and the Forty-five Martyrs, and the virgins Justina, Euphemia, and Christina. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [BK]: "We bless You, Lord."

7. Tuesday. Tone 2 [BK]. Of Bishop Athenogenes, and the ten disciples, and the five Martyrs. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [BK]: "Who in the battle."

8. Wednesday. Tone 5 [GCh / GDz]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 1 [AK]: "Glorified forever, God."

9. Thursday. Tone 3 [GK]. Of the Forefathers Adam, Abel, etc.

11. Saturday. Tone 7 [DK]. Of the Sons and Grandsons of Saint Gregory the Illuminator, etc.

12. Sunday. Tone 4 [AZ / ADz]. Third [Sunday]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [B3 / BDz]: "Incorruptible."

13. Monday. Tone 1 [AK]. Of the Maccabees, etc. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [G3 / GDz]: "Who the torments."

14. Tuesday. Tone 6 [BCh / BDz]. Of the Twelve Prophets: Hosea, etc.

16. Thursday. Tone 5 [GZ / GDz]. Of Sophia, etc. Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [BK]: "Those who trusted."

18. Saturday. Of Bishop Demetrius, Bishop Blaise, and Absalom the Deacon. [Feasts] in the middle of Apai [after Transfiguration].

19. Sunday. Tone 7 [DK]. Fourth [Sunday]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [BK]: "Who in the heavenly." First Sunday of Apai.

Monday. Tone 4 [AZ / ADz]. Of Anthony the Hermit.

Tuesday. Tone 1 [AK]. Of King Theodosius, and the youths of Ephesus.

Thursday. Tone 2 [BK]. Of Cyriacus and Julietta. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [G3 / GDz]: "Holy are You, Lord."

Saturday. Tone 3 [GK]. Of the Patriarchs Athanasius and Cyril.

Sunday. Tone 8 [DZ / DDz]. Fifth [Sunday]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [BK]: "Without beginning." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [DZ / DDz]: "Anticipating with the women." Second Sunday of Apai.

Monday. Tone 7 [DK]. Of Vahan of Golthen, and Gordius, etc. Canticle [Harts] Tone 7 [DK]: "To You, O God."

Tuesday. Tone 4 [AZ / ADz]. Of Tryphon, Parsamas, and Onuphrius the hermits.

Thursday. Tone 6 [BZ / BDz]. Of Catherine [Eugenia] the virgin, and her father Philip, etc. Canticle [Harts] Tone 3 [GK]: "Who the wondrous."

August

Saturday. Tone 5 [GDz]. Of Gregory the Theologian [Nazianzen], Patriarch.

Sunday. Tone 3 [GK]. Sixth [Sunday]. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [G3 / GDz]: "We glorify." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [GK]: "The divine tomb." Third Sunday of Apai.

Monday. Tone 8 [DDz]. Of Eugenius, Macarius, etc. Canticle [Harts] Tone 1 [ADz]: "You, the righteous." See after the Assumption of the Mother of God for the fourth week.

Tuesday. Tone 7 [DK]. Of Andrew the General, and his army, etc.

Wednesday. Tone 1 [ADz]. Canticle of Fasting [Harts] Tone 4 [B3 / BDz]: "Who fears."

Thursday. Tone 1 [AK]. Of Adrian and his wife, etc. Canticle [Harts] Tone 1 [AK]: "Holy God."

Saturday. Tone 2 [BK]. Of the holy Council of Ephesus, the two hundred Patriarchs.

Sunday. Tone 5 [GDz]. Seventh [Sunday]. Eve of the Fast of the Mother of God. Canticle [Harts] Tone 5 [G3 / GDz]: "Glorified Son of God." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 5 [G3 / GDz]: "Ointment-bearing [women]," and "Today [is the resurrection]."

Monday. Tone 3 [GK]. Fast of the Holy Mother of God. Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [B3 / BDz]: "Straight are the ways."

Sunday. Tone 2 [BK]. Assumption of the Mother of God [Verapokhumn]. The privilege period [of eating meat] is three weeks.
